messages:
Sam: Thanks for the great all-hands today — quick thread to capture the security/privacy follow-ups and owners. TL;DR: SOC2 evidence bundle, VPC peering checklist, audit-log retention options, and BYOK/KMS next steps.
Jordan: I can own the SOC2 evidence pack. I'll start by exporting the control evidence and a matrix mapping controls->owners. Target: initial draft by EOD Tue.
Leah: Appreciate it. Can we flag any product-level gaps (e.g., default logging for new routes) so PM can triage?
Ravi: Noted. I'll run a quick sweep of recently shipped routes tomorrow and post a short list.
Anna: For VPC, Infra will publish the peering checklist + required subnets and CIDR ranges. ETA: Thu COB. Also adding the private link doc to the workspace.
Jordan: Audit logs — two asks from legal/compliance: 1) retention policy options (90/365/indef) and 2) an export path that is auditable. I'll prototype an S3 export with immutability (Object Lock) and share sample config.
Sam: On retention, leadership prefers default 365 for now unless a specific customer/regulatory need dictates otherwise. Provide a cost estimate for each option.
Jordan: Will do. Also propose we add a short script to periodically verify log export integrity (hash check).
Anna: Sharing rough command we'll use for the export. Please review:
```
aws s3 cp /var/log/redwood/audit.json s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-03-24/ --storage-class STANDARD_IA --object-lock-mode GOVERNANCE
# then run: sha256sum audit.json > audit.json.sha256
```
Ravi: For product-level logging we should standardize a small schema (ts, user_id, route, model_id, decision_flags) — I'll draft and push to the spec repo.
Leah: Good call. We should also add a note about redaction for PII fields.
Jordan: KMS/BYOK — short notes from the all-hands: customers want BYOK with rotation and split-knowledge support. We're going to publish a roadmap note: Q2 for BYOK alpha (VPC + KMS integration), Q3 for HSM-backed BYOK for enterprise.
Sam: Make sure we capture SLAs for key management and clear limitations for export/import during migration.
Anna: We'll add KMS key policy templates for common cloud providers to the docs.
Ravi: One technical question — will we allow customers to bring keys to our hosted tenants, or only to Dedicated/Private?
Jordan: Short answer: BYOK will be available for Dedicated and Private first. Hosted tenants will get a managed-KMS option with customer-managed keys in partner clouds as a next step. We'll include compatibility notes.
Sam: Action summary (assignments): Jordan -> SOC2 evidence pack + retention options + log export prototype. Anna -> VPC peering checklist + KMS key policy templates. Ravi -> product logging schema + route sweep. Leah -> compile product gaps and PII redaction guidance. Sam -> coordinate with legal on acceptance criteria.
Leah: I'll collect the product gaps into a single doc and link here when ready.
Jordan: I'll drop the S3 export example and a small verification script in #eng-infra tomorrow and tag the compliance folks.
DeployBot: Incident 2026-03-24-001 created: export-job-failed - tagging @Jordan @Anna for follow-up.
Anna: Thanks DeployBot — looking into the failed job now, will post root cause in #eng-oncall.
Ravi: Re: timeline, team — do we want a weekly sync for the next 3 weeks to keep momentum? 30 min: Tue 9am PT?
Sam: Yes, schedule weekly sync. Leah/Anna/Jordan/Ravi please accept calendar invite.
Leah: Ack, will accept and add the agenda template.
Jordan: One more: can we automate evidence capture where possible? e.g., snapshot of config and a signed hash stored in the evidence bucket. I'll prototype with a lambda.
Sam: Love it. Automate where feasible. Let's keep this thread for updates — paste links to docs/actions when you add them. :thumbsup:
